description: This file defines the class LuceneContentPickerResultProvider, which implements search functionality for content items using Lucene indexing within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for searching content based on query and content types, and returns search results with content item details.

classes.name: LuceneContentPickerResultProvider
classes.description: Implements content search using Lucene for OrchardCore, providing search results based on query and content types.
